text: {"lessons":["Over these ten periods, frequent changes did not produce lasting gains; I should trade only when a decision has a clear rationale, not just to stay active.","A short run of account results is noisy, so I should assess decisions over time and compare my returns with the market rather than judge them by one month's move.","Before each trade, I should check how it affects the whole portfolio and keep enough cash to handle risk without being forced to sell."]}
